notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/cardfinancialcondition.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/cardfinancialcondition.md at e7ed622 (“docs: publish 19 Component Fix fixes on jfs-components dbe0e02”, 28 October). The guide's Sources note was checked on 28 October 2026 on the installed build (jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October), so items citing it carry 2026-10-28 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02. The evidence has a dbe0e02 publish section (verified 27 October on dbe0e02, #350), which replaces the older sections where they differ, and older sections checked on 19 October on c7d3348 (Contract, Modes and tokens, Web render); items citing those carry 2026-10-19 and 0.1.78-c7d3348. GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c7d3348 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (195 files, complete) touches no token or resolver file; for this card it changes only CardFinancialCondition.tsx line 328 (the default spoken name now passes progressState) and financialConditionName.ts (Inactive leaves out the score), plus Nudge.tsx (closeAccessibilityLabel, a 28 px close, dev warnings, and a numeric title lineHeight), none of which reaches the card's nudge, which has no title and no close. Checked against the installed source, read, not run, with token values through the package's own getVariableByName (lib/commonjs/design-tokens/figma-variables-resolver.js): COMPONENT_DEFAULT_MODES is AppearanceBrand Neutral, Context Nudge&Alert, Nudge padding None (CardFinancialCondition.tsx 73–77), merged under the theme's and the card's own modes (278–286); the button always gets AppearanceBrand Secondary and Context CTACard over the card's modes (295–298), and buttonSlot children get those button modes (318–325) while progressSlot and nudgeSlot children get the card's (300–316); the root is a column with alignItems flex-start, no width, 16 px padding, radius 16, gap 8 (205–214); the header row has gap 16 and width 100% (215–220); title and body are plain Text with no numberOfLines, so they wrap (338–339); the default ring is CircularProgressBar with state, value and valueLabel (342–349), 60 px at the default circularProgressBar Size S (164 at M), Inactive by default, clamping value to 0–100 and showing valueLabel or the rounded value only when Active (CircularProgressBar.tsx 92, 119–120, 200, 240–258); showNudge gates the default Nudge (inline-compact, nudgeBody in a Text child, no title, no close because neither showClose nor onClose is passed; Nudge.tsx 316–320) and nudgeSlot (352–358); showDivider gates the Divider (360); showButton gates the Button and buttonSlot (362–372); the default spoken name is financialConditionName(title, body, value, valueLabel, progressState) (327–328), which leaves the score out while progressState is Inactive or false and otherwise reads “title, score. body” with no doubled period (financialConditionName.ts 1–22). Resolved token values (Light, the card's defaults): card background white for every AppearanceBrand, System status and Color Mode tried, radius 16, padding 16, gap 8, header gap 16, title 16/700 on an 18 line, body 14; ring arc Neutral rgb(48,51,56), Primary rgb(206,161,90), Secondary rgb(93,0,181), Tertiary rgb(2,107,154); nudge background Neutral white, Primary rgb(254,244,229), Secondary rgb(246,243,255), Tertiary rgb(236,247,255); button rgb(93,0,181) for every AppearanceBrand; Semantic Intent System positive gives a green ring rgb(0,119,61), nudge rgb(219,240,217) and button rgb(38,171,33), negative a red ring rgb(188,1,12), nudge rgb(255,224,222) and button rgb(245,0,48); AppearanceSystem without Semantic Intent System changes nothing; Emphasis Medium gives a pale ring rgb(214,214,217) and button rgb(228,219,255), Low rgb(245,245,245) and a transparent button, the nudge unchanged; the button's padding is 4 × 16 with 14/22 text (32 px) at Context Default, Nudge&Alert and ListItem and at Button / Size S and XS, so neither Context nor Button / Size changes it (the evidence names no Button / Size effect, so it is noted here and not recorded as a fact); Nudge padding Default gives 12 px; Border Boolean True gives the nudge a rgb(235,235,237) border; context 10 jioPlus turns the divider rgb(25,31,110). Every guide sentence used here holds on the installed build, so nothing is left out as contradicted and there are no human flags. Superseded and not used: the evidence Contract line “The default ignores `progressState`, so an Inactive card still reads the value” and the Hosting line on Inactive cards passing accessibilityLabel 'Protection. No score yet', both replaced by the dbe0e02 section; the 17 and 19 October measurements of the older 25 px button. Not recorded: style, headerStyle, titleStyle and bodyStyle (the building rules keep style overrides off Coin components) and the guide's style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 343 }} host frame, since the card fills its host; testID and the other View props; the evidence's Figma layer details and Code Connect; Biscuit's unpublished CardFinancialCondition.mdx (use, avoid and accessibilityLabel advice the guide doesn't give), so avoidWhen stays empty: the guide names no case or component to use instead; the exported financialConditionName helper; circularProgressBar Size, Border Boolean, Nudge padding, Button / State and context 10 beyond their facts, which the guide doesn't show; Page type, Context2, Slot gap and Profile Card Appearance, which the evidence says change nothing visible; dark mode (the card stays white in every Color Mode), which the pack's rules keep out of gaps. Anatomy: Title, Body and Score are always present (title and body have defaults; the ring is the default unless progressSlot replaces it); Nudge, Divider and Button are false, since showNudge, showDivider and showButton remove them. content.bad holds the Don't's paragraph nudge. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode, no AppearanceBrand Neutral (the card's default), no Slot gap on the VStack (the guide's In context sets M; the VStack stretches its children, stackAlignment.ts), and no style frame; the built-in button gets only buttonLabel and onPressButton; every card passes progressState Active, since the default Inactive hides the score; content is passed explicitly with the guide's own copy (Your money, October 2026, Protection, Check your coverage and gaps, the two-line nudge, View details, Your cover looks complete, You have gaps in your cover, 72, 90, 30); the second example is the In context card once cover is added, which the guide's source sets to value 90 and body “Your cover looks complete” with showNudge false (cardfinancialcondition.guide.tsx 126–128; the copy snapshot renders the screen before the press). The third example sets Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, as the configuration says for a score to act on; it is set for the score's meaning, and it reaches the ring, the nudge and the button as the guide shows, not to restyle the button. Title has an undocumented entry. Left out of examples (three at most): Neutral and Primary alone, Positive, Without the nudge, Without the divider, Inactive, valueLabel, Long copy, the Don'ts and the playground. Gaps: the guide's Sources note that Figma's nudge is the retired Nudge with a purple sparkle, which no mode reproduces, and that the published Storybook still shows the older generated page (the evidence's Discrepancies: it lists collection defaults Primary / Default / Default, not the card's Neutral / Nudge&Alert / None); no open ticket was found for either. #285 and #350 (Component Bugs) are fixed on dbe0e02. Sorting (batch 9, first cross-check): our misreadings fixed: the Active spoken name now says it applies while the ring is Active; the circularProgressBar Size fact no longer names a 60 px S default the evidence doesn't state; the Figma sparkle gap no longer turns the page's choice to follow Neutral into card behaviour; the white-card rule no longer says which parts modes colour (context 10 also recolours the divider); “Your cover looks complete” left content.good, since the guide doesn't present it as sample copy. The In context example's copy is the guide's own and its flag is dismissed in reviews/cardfinancialcondition.json.

    value={72}
    nudgeBody={'There may be gaps in your health or life cover\nAdd coverage to stay financially secure'}
    buttonLabel="View details"
    onPressButton={() => {}}
  />
</VStack>
